reason: 99 euros a month is nothing if it really takes the night-time emails and posts off my plate, but 'AI co-workers' is a big promise and I've paid for tools that just gave me one more thing to set up. This month I'd try the free plan or book the demo, I wouldn't pay yet.
objection: Will it actually answer my customers and post in my voice without me checking everything at 11pm, or will I end up babysitting it and fixing its mistakes? And what does a 'credit' get me, will 100 run out in a week?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle a week of my real customer emails and social posts in the free trial or demo, with a clear number of hours saved and what 100 credits actually covers.
